economy.summary: Her campaign platform calls for lower taxes, reduced regulations, and halting government overspending.
economy.short: Calls for lower taxes, reduced regulations, halting government overspending.

taxes.summary: Introduced House Bill 1649, the School Property Tax Elimination Act, which would replace school property taxes with increases to the personal income tax and sales tax; she said the legislation is about fairness, sustainability, and keeping families from being taxed out of their homes.
taxes.short: Proposes eliminating school property taxes via income, sales taxes.

abortion.summary: Describes herself as '100% pro-life' and has pledged to vote every time to protect the life of an unborn child; she sponsored HB 320, a bill that would prohibit abortion after fetal cardiac activity is detected.
abortion.short: Describes herself pro-life; sponsored bill prohibiting abortion after cardiac activity.

education.summary: Her campaign platform supports school choice, accountability measures, and parental involvement, saying academic and social standards are rapidly declining; she calls for eliminating what she describes as 'woke curriculum' in favor of core competencies.
education.short: Supports school choice, parental involvement; opposes 'woke curriculum'.

guns.summary: Her campaign platform lists safeguarding the Second Amendment right of self-protection among her priorities; it does not detail specific gun legislation.
guns.short: Platform supports safeguarding Second Amendment right of self-protection.
